answer: Give each agent identity a peer-prediction reputation vault: weight comes only from grading peers, paid by accuracy against the consensus panel, so lazy or rigged grading earns nothing while honest graders compound reputation and voting power. A sybil must build a karst of hollow identities and grow each one through genuine-looking grading, yet clones betray a shared pigment — correlated errors the panel flags — so the attacker locks stake in every identity and bleeds staked losses larger than any one vote could ever earn.
